diagnosis: On Windows, concurrent creation of a missing parent changes GetFinalPathName failure from WinError 3 to WinError 2 during one non-strict Path.resolve call. CPython retains an extended DOS prefix for the target while resolving the root without that prefix, so is_relative_to falsely rejects a contained path.
fix: Use a common canonical namespace for ordinary and extended absolute DOS/UNC paths before containment comparison. Reject other device namespaces and malformed UNC roots; keep root, parent and file symlink checks and relative escape rejection.
independent_review: Runtime agent read-only review found no namespace bypass introduced by normalization.

regression.interleaving: Create the real ranks directory after the first failed target resolution and before non-strict resolution finishes.

release_boundary: The prior release-final-review.json records only source 7efd87fbaacf612d2b8581866327923d2a52a771 and candidate a6-release-v1. This fix requires rebuilt unpublished Assets wheels, a new source commit and a regenerated candidate before publication. No ready/partial assertions or release gates were weakened.
external_actions: None: diagnosis and tests used synthetic local data, blocked application networking and temporary directories; no publication or host changes.
